snippet.title: Sylv and the Ancient Tree - First look Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam Page :
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4589200/Sylv_and_the_Ancient_Tree/

Hello, everyone! I'm Kel, a new developer, and I'd like to present my project in development, ‘Sylv and The Ancient Tree’, my little tribute to the adventure and platform genre. The game draws directly from games such as the Monster Boy series, which masterfully combined adventure, exploration, and boss battles. Demo Available soon.
